== Biography ==
'''Mary Leggat Glasgow''' was born in Port Glasgow, Scotland, the youngest daughter of Captain Robert Glasgow.  

She married James Bryce on 10 July 1867. James was a minister, ordained at Newark, Port Glasgow, in 1862 and later translated to another parish in 1877.  

Mary and James had three children:  
* '''Williamson Bryce''', born 23 May 1868  
* '''John Bryce''', born 4 December 1869  
* '''Mary Leggat Watson Bryce''', born 19 May 1871  

Mary passed away on 25 April 1875.

<blockquote>
JAMES BRYCE, born Mossland, Renfrew, 1832, son of John B. and Mary Watson ; educated at Renfrew School and Univ. of Glasgow ; assistant at Carluke and Dairy ; ord. to Newark, Port-Glasgow, 9th Jan. 1862 ; trans, and adm. 16th May 1877 ; died 14th Oct. 1886. He marr. 10th July 1867, Mary Leggat (died 25th April 1875), youngest daugh. of Captain Robert Glasgow, Port - Glasgow, and had issue — Williamson, born 23rd May 1868; John, born 4th Dec. 1869; Mary Leggat Watson, born 19th May 1871.</blockquote><ref>https://archive.org/details/fastiecclesiaesc03scot/mode/2up?q=%22Robert+Glasgow%22</ref>
